ticket.meaning: Unplanned maintenance intervention / breakdown event on the shop floor
ticket.avoid: IT helpdesk ticket unless that is the only natural term

PM.prefer: Keep PM acronym or expand once in parentheses

takeover.meaning: Technician accepts and works an open ticket

closeout.meaning: Supervisor sign-off; ticket becomes CLOSED and goes to history

hold.meaning: Ticket paused (waiting on parts, vendor, or information)

escalate.meaning: Hand ticket up to higher skill level or supervisor

tooling.meaning: Physical tools, fixtures, dies — not software development tooling

ledger.meaning: List/table screen with search and filters (assets, inventory, etc.)

PIC.meaning: Person In Charge named on a ticket

badge number.meaning: Employee I-badge / public-safe ID used for login
